fields.description: Issue features Miami Life editorials and local political coverage, including a proposal for a nightly radio “political clinic” to give all candidates airtime and criticism of Miami’s daily newspapers’ handling of elections. Reports discuss Miami Beach city council maneuvering involving City Manager Renshaw and police department control, with mention of gambling conditions. Substantial attention is given to opposition to a Florida sales tax during a special legislative session, including publication of reader names signing anti–sales tax coupons and commentary on the Retail Merchants Association. The issue also reprints and comments on an Atlanta Journal editorial about Chattanooga’s municipally owned electric utility as part of Miami Life’s advocacy regarding Florida Power & Light and electric rates, alongside local court/police items and public-safety/health notes (including pesticide cautions).
